evals.prompt: What's out of sync between my desktop and laptop checkouts? Uncommitted stuff, unpushed branches, repos only on one of them.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs snapshot --share on this PC (or reads the share), then compare; reports drift per repo and host (missing clones, unpushed branches, dirty or conflicted trees, stale fetches) and offers plan; does not run any sync step.

evals.prompt: Which repos can I safely pull on beta, and which need me to look at them first?
evals.expected_behavior: Runs plan over the snapshots (share or --ssh beta); lists SAFE fetch / pull --ff-only commands only for clean repos on the default branch that are behind, and NEEDS HUMAN items with reasons; never executes them without the user's go-ahead.

evals.prompt: I renamed acme/old-tool to acme/new-tool on GitHub and the PCs now show them as different repos in the inventory.
evals.expected_behavior: Uses an alias map ({"acme/old-tool": "acme/new-tool"}) via --aliases or the config so compare groups both checkouts under one key.

evals.prompt: Send the other PC's agent a short digest of my repo state over agent mail.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs snapshot --summary (under 16 KB) and hands the text to agent-mailbox as the body; does not paste the full JSON.

evals.prompt: Show me README.md in this repo's checkout on the laptop.
evals.expected_behavior: cross-pc-ssh (one repository, a file on the peer), not this skill.

evals.prompt: Leave a handoff note for the agent on the other PC about tomorrow's work.
